description: Use when you need to find compute derivative contracts. Searches futures and options on GPU rental indices by venue, status, index publisher, jurisdiction, settlement or name. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

index_publisher.description: Restrict to contracts settling against one publisher's index, for example "Silicon Data".

jurisdiction.description: Two letter country code of the listing venue, for example US.

query.description: Words matched against the contract name, code, venue and index, for example "H100" or "NYMEX".

venue.description: Restrict to one venue by short name, for example NYMEX or ICE.

name: search_compute_contracts
title: Search compute derivative contracts
